name: Agent Blueprint
description: Methodology and platform for designing and deploying enterprise AI agent teams. Each engagement produces a living blueprint: readiness evidence, a ranked use-case portfolio, agent team designs, business cases, and Agent Skills directories for coding agents. Delivered through hands-on engagements, not self-serve signup.
